gate.rule: AC power AND 1-min load < 1.5 AND no cargo/rustc process

latest_artifact_method.estimator: ceil(chars / 4) — documented ESTIMATE, same as src/formatter.ts; sensitivity estimator ceil(chars/3.5) also reported
latest_artifact_method.design: counterbalanced A/B alternating arm order; 30 paired observations across 6 tasks
latest_artifact_method.ci: BCa bootstrap, 10000 resamples, alpha=0.05, on paired deltas
latest_artifact_method.ultraArm: Pi tool formatting path (index.ts -> formatGrepFiles / path listing)
latest_artifact_method.nativeArm: raw stdout of the equivalent rg/find command in the same workspace
latest_artifact_method.heuristic: legacy 150 + 75×hits (grep) / 100 + 30×hits (path) comparison; labelled an ESTIMATE everywhere

sample: `Tokens Saved (ESTIMATE ONLY — formula 150+75×hits, not measured; see bench/results/TOKENS.md): ${summary.totalTokensSaved.toLocaleString()}`

defects: measurement artifact status=degraded, gate=provisional: the measured deltas may not be cited as production evidence
